question: What's my balance?
title: Your balance, row by row

cells.title: From the balance to safe to spend
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

s = kori.safe_to_spend()
rows = s.get("from_balance") or []                # missing when only part of the money is on this account
parts = [{"label": r["label"], "amount": r["amount"]} for r in rows if r["sign"] == "-"]
if rows:
    emit("balance", rows[0]["amount"], "eur", rows[0]["label"])
    emit("balance_label", rows[0]["label"], "text", "What the first row is")
    emit("safe_to_spend", rows[-1]["amount"], "eur", rows[-1]["label"])
    emit("safe_label", rows[-1]["label"], "text", "What the last row is")
    emit("next_payday", s["next_payday"], "date", "Next payday")
    buffer = next((x for x in s.get("spoken_for") or [] if x.get("key") == "buffer" and x.get("detail")), None)
    emit("note", buffer["detail"] if buffer else s["status_line"], "text", "About the money kept back")
    if parts:
        table("parts", parts, "Already spoken for, until payday")
adds_up = bool(rows) and bool(parts) and rows[0]["sign"] == "+" and rows[-1]["sign"] == "=" and \
    abs(rows[0]["amount"] - sum(p["amount"] for p in parts) - rows[-1]["amount"]) < 0.005
if adds_up:                                       # the screen shows a sum, so it must add up to the cent
    if rows[-1]["amount"] > 0:
        say(f"Your balance is **{eur(rows[0]['amount'], True)}**. Until {PAY} on {day(s['next_payday'])}, {eur(rows[-1]['amount'], True)} of it is safe to spend: the rest is already spoken for.")
    else:
        say(f"Your balance is **{eur(rows[0]['amount'], True)}**, but none of it is safe to spend until {PAY} on {day(s['next_payday'])}. " + s["status_line"])
